hooks.name: on-exorcise-defect
hooks.description: After the agent edits the scanner or the healer, make sure the three sample programs still produce the documented pathologies and that healing leaves none.

action.command: changed=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("tool_input",{}).get("path",""))'); case "$changed" in *necro-core/src/scan.rs|*necro-core/src/heal.rs) cargo test --quiet --release -p necro-cobol-lifter --test lifter ;; esac
